releases.changelog: Each VeraLux process now states what a drag's preview frame may run over: VeraLux Curves, whose curve reads each pixel alone, previews a drag over the view's reduction; Alchemy, HyperMetric Stretch, Nox, Silentium, Revela, Vectra and StarComposer, which measure the whole image in every preview, state that they preview it whole.
releases.signature_detail: Unsigned official package; SHA-256 verified from index
